title: MIC intervention qualification and NPZ contracts
description: JSON validates qualification metadata; x-npz-contracts describes NPZ arrays checked by the CLI. No data instances are included.

conventions.N: one person's trials, at most500; source fitting uses all source rows
conventions.Q: 199 frozen arbitrary codebooks for real factorials; smaller synthetic fixtures allowed
conventions.R: one B4 readout or two ordered B4,PCA16 readouts
conventions.T: 35 ordered target people for real summaries
conventions.S: 35 complete source-person deletions for real sensitivity
conventions.objects: Object/pickle NPZ fields prohibited; all IDs/UIDs use non-object Unicode/byte string arrays
conventions.units: BA is a proportion; all contrasts and sensitivity inputs are percentage points
conventions.bootstrap: Frozen supplied integer [9999,T] resample indices; code rows are not statistical units

phase_features.I: finite float [N,F], paired and same original row order
phase_features.y: integer [N], true heard class0/1; both classes
phase_features.owner: string [N], one target or grouped source people
phase_features.onset_log_sec: finite float [N], original behavior-log onset seconds; required for factorial matching

source_model.fields: Existing INPUT_SCHEMAS.json complete MEG source model; scaler_mean/scaler_scale/pca_mean/pca_components/p_mean/i_mean/B4_P_weights/B4_I_weights/source_ids/source_original_uids/modality
source_model.source_rows: All allowed P/I rows; target/heldout person and UID sets disjoint from fitted source model
source_model.refit_source: refit-source removes the specified entire person from full35; retains34 and refits every source numerical stage

frozen_codes.labels: integer [Q,N],0/1; frozen true-label class multiset per code
frozen_codes.original_donor: optional integer [Q,N]; if supplied must equal strict nearest donor on eligible common support

factorial_plan.labels: original integer [Q,N], never modified for scoring
factorial_plan.k: integer [Q,N], strict same-code nearest nonself donor, -1 if unsupported
factorial_plan.l: integer [Q,N], shared strict opposite-code nearest partner, -1 if unsupported
factorial_plan.eligible: Boolean [Q,N], supports both k and l
factorial_plan.reason_code: integer [Q,N]:0 eligible,1 no strict same-code donor,2 no strict opposite-code partner; reason1 has priority
factorial_plan.pause_halfblock: same ordered half metadata as input
factorial_plan.onset_log_sec: same original log seconds as input

factorial_score_output.per_code_BA: float [Q,R,4], class-balanced on identical eligible support
factorial_score_output.endpoint_values: float [M], BA proportions or named pp contrasts
factorial_score_output.scope: scalar data scope string; all generated fixtures SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY

factorial_summary_input.person_order: unique string [T], original frozen person order
factorial_summary_input.participant_row_resamples: frozen integer [9999,T], each row samples all T people with replacement

source_sensitivity_input.source_order: unique string [S], one actual whole-source deletion per row, all reported
source_sensitivity_input.target_order: unique string [T], same full-source/deletion target order; disjoint from source_order
source_sensitivity_input.deleted_source_person_contrasts_pp: finite float [S,T] from complete refits, same support/codebooks
source_sensitivity_input.paired_alternative: Instead of the two contrast arrays, supply full_endpoint_pairs_pp [T,2] and deleted_endpoint_pairs_pp [S,T,2]; endpoint0 minus endpoint1 before sensitivity calculation
source_sensitivity_input.qualification: complete_source_refits_verified and same_target_support_verified must be true

source_direction_prior_output.source_delta: finite float [16], equal-person true-class P difference through corresponding model
source_direction_prior_output.model_reference: scalar local model path, runtime-only outside public repository
source_direction_prior_output.model_mtime_ns: integer local modification time; metadata binding is not historical identity proof

source_selection_input.source_person_BA: finite proportion [35,5], equal-person LOPO with held person excluded from scaler/PCA/B4/prior
source_selection_input.qualification: source_LOPO_exclusion_verified must be true; no target scores used

frozen_selection_json.chosen_lambda: one of0,.25,.5,.75,1; tie within1e-12 takes smaller weight
frozen_selection_json.data_scope: USER_SUPPLIED_ADMITTED_DATA or SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY; must match target scope
frozen_selection_json.scope: exploratory source-only selection; historical exposure remains

direction_score_output.method_BA: proportion [4], equal class weighting for this person
